newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold futures end firmer on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold futures end firmer on weak yen.

text.p: Yen-denominated Tokyo gold futures ended slightly higher on Wednesday, as private investors' selling lost steam later in the day, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
The spot September contract expired at noon at 1,345 yen with 68 lots of deliveries. Other prices ranged from three to six yen per gram higher, with benchmark August ending up three at 1,338 yen.
Spot gold was quoted at $382.65/382.95 per ounce at the Tokyo close, against $382.60/383.10 in New York on Tuesday.
